# API reference

Every `@frappe.whitelist()` function is a **public HTTP endpoint** reachable at
`/api/method/<dotted.path>`. This file is the complete list.

- **120 endpoints**
- **5 reachable without login** (`allow_guest=True`)
- **95 with no in-body permission call** - see the note below

## Guest-reachable endpoints

These answer before any login. Each needs a justification in its docstring.

| Endpoint | Methods | Summary |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `vansale.api.auth.login` | POST | Cookie-based login for the web PWA (also used for initial PIN setup). |
| `vansale.api.auth.login_with_pin` | POST | PIN unlock for the native APK. |
| `vansale.api.auth.site_info` | GET | Pre-login connectivity probe for the APK's site-URL setup screen. |
| `vansale.api.util.get_csrf_token` | GET | Return the CSRF token for the current session. |
| `vansale.api.util.version_compat` | GET | Lightweight "is the SPA still compatible with this server?" probe. |

## Endpoints without an explicit permission call

Absence is **not** proof of a hole: most are safe because every query is scoped
to `frappe.session.user`, or they only read reference data a Van User already
holds DocType read permission on. This is a review list, not a bug list - but
anything here that writes, or reads another user's data, needs an explicit
`frappe.has_permission` call.

## All endpoints by module


### `vansale.api.admin`

#### `set_user_password` - POST / _no perm call_

Set a password for a user listed in at least one Vansale Configuration.

```
/api/method/vansale.api.admin.set_user_password
(user: str, new_password: str)
```

<sub>vansale/api/admin.py:24</sub>

#### `users_without_password` - GET / _no perm call_

List Van Users who have no password yet (so the admin can reset them in bulk).

```
/api/method/vansale.api.admin.users_without_password
(no arguments)
```

<sub>vansale/api/admin.py:52</sub>


### `vansale.api.auth`

#### `change_pin` - POST / _no perm call_

Change the logged-in user's PIN. Does NOT rotate api_secret.

```
/api/method/vansale.api.auth.change_pin
(old_pin: str, new_pin: str)
```

<sub>vansale/api/auth.py:226</sub>

#### `login` - **GUEST** / POST

Cookie-based login for the web PWA (also used for initial PIN setup).

```
/api/method/vansale.api.auth.login
(usr: str, pwd: str)
```

<sub>vansale/api/auth.py:99</sub>

#### `login_with_pin` - **GUEST** / POST

PIN unlock for the native APK.

```
/api/method/vansale.api.auth.login_with_pin
(email: str, pin: str)
```

<sub>vansale/api/auth.py:181</sub>

#### `logout` - POST / _no perm call_

Explicit logout — clears the session cookie. Token auth on the APK is cleared client-side by wiping Preferences; no server rotation needed.

```
/api/method/vansale.api.auth.logout
(no arguments)
```

<sub>vansale/api/auth.py:339</sub>

#### `ping` - _no perm call_

Liveness probe used by the client to verify a cached token still works.

```
/api/method/vansale.api.auth.ping
(no arguments)
```

<sub>vansale/api/auth.py:329</sub>

#### `reset_pin` - POST

Admin PIN reset — clears the target user's PIN so they set a new one.

```
/api/method/vansale.api.auth.reset_pin
(user: str)
```

<sub>vansale/api/auth.py:279</sub>

#### `setup_pin` - POST / _no perm call_

Set or replace the logged-in user's PIN.

```
/api/method/vansale.api.auth.setup_pin
(pin: str)
```

<sub>vansale/api/auth.py:136</sub>

#### `site_info` - **GUEST** / GET

Pre-login connectivity probe for the APK's site-URL setup screen.

```
/api/method/vansale.api.auth.site_info
(no arguments)
```

<sub>vansale/api/auth.py:313</sub>

```

<sub>vansale/api/payment.py:466</sub>

#### `save` - POST

Allocation rules (PDF §2d): - `advance` (setting "Allow advance payment") → no allocation at all; the whole amount stays as the customer's advance / credit - `invoice_names` list provided → allocate FIFO across the picked invoices in the given order - `invoice_name` single provided → allocate against that invoice only - neither provided → FIFO auto-allocate across ALL outstanding invoices for the customer, oldest first; any leftover remains unallocated (customer credit)

```
/api/method/vansale.api.payment.save
(client_id: str, customer: str, paid_amount: float, mode_of_payment: str = 'Cash', reference_no: Optional[str] = None, reference_date: Optional[str] = None, invoice_name: Optional[str] = None, invoice_names: Optional[list[str]] = None, posting_ts: Optional[str] = None, remarks: Optional[str] = None, submit: int = 1, advance: int = 0)
```

### `vansale.steelforce.approvals`

#### `apply` - POST / _no perm call_

Take `action` on one document as the signed-in user, through Permission Manager. The action must be one the document offers the user now, with the comment or attachment it requires. `expected_state` is the document's workflow state when the user opened it: when given and the document has moved since, it is refused before PM is asked. A blank `priority` leaves the transition's own priority; a chosen one is Low, Medium, High or Critical. Any refusal (PM's or the document's own) is raised unchanged. Returns `{"ok": True, "new_state", "recommended"}`; `recommended` is true when the user was asked for advice and the document did not move.

```
/api/method/vansale.steelforce.approvals.apply
(doctype: str, name: str, action: str, comment: str = '', priority: str = '', expected_state: str = '')
```

<sub>vansale/steelforce/approvals.py:226</sub>

#### `apply_bulk` - POST

Take `action` on up to 20 documents of one type, one by one, with the same checks as `apply`. `names` is a JSON list (duplicates are dropped); `expected_states` is a JSON object `{docname: state when listed}`, and a document that moved since fails (a name not in it is not checked). A document on which the user was only asked for advice fails too: that is answered from its own screen. Each document is committed on success and rolled back on failure, and one failure never stops the others. Returns `{"results": [{"docname", "ok", "message"}], "ok_count", "failed_count"}`, where `message` is the refusal as plain text.

```
/api/method/vansale.steelforce.approvals.apply_bulk

<sub>vansale/steelforce/approvals.py:131</sub>


### `vansale.steelforce.approvals_extra`

#### `attach` - POST

Attach a file (base64, no data-URL prefix) to a document the signed-in user has to act on, so an action that requires an attachment can follow. The caller must hold an open approval on the document they may act on (PM's rule) and may read it; anyone else, and Stock Entry and types PM hides, are refused before any file is made. The file is private; its name is cleaned and decoded by the app's own upload. Returns `{"name", "url"}` of the File.

```
/api/method/vansale.steelforce.approvals_extra.attach
(doctype: str, name: str, filename: str, content_base64: str)
```

<sub>vansale/steelforce/approvals_extra.py:234</sub>

#### `forward` - POST / _no perm call_

Forward the signed-in user's open approval `action_id` to `to_user`, through Permission Manager (which makes the other person's approval and does not share the document). The caller must hold the approval (PM lets them act on it and it is still open); otherwise, and for an approval on Stock Entry or a type PM hides, the answer is "Approval not found", the same as for an id that does not exist. `return_to_originator` asks the other person for advice only: the approval comes back to the caller. Returns PM's answer, `{"adhoc_action", "return_to_originator"}`. `to_user` must be an enabled system user other than the caller who may read the document, as the people offered by `forward_targets` are; anyone else is refused before PM is asked.

```
/api/method/vansale.steelforce.approvals_extra.forward
(action_id: str, to_user: str, comment: str = '', return_to_originator: int = 0)
```

<sub>vansale/steelforce/approvals_extra.py:144</sub>

#### `forward_targets` - GET

Up to 20 people the document can be forwarded to: enabled system users whose user id or full name contains `query`, left out unless they may read this document (a forward does not share it), and never the caller. Each is `{"user", "full_name", "role"}`; `role` is the person's first role that appears on the workflow's transitions for the document's current state, or "". The caller needs read permission on the document; Stock Entry and types PM hides from its inbox are refused. Empty when Permission Manager is not installed.

```
/api/method/vansale.steelforce.approvals_extra.forward_targets
(doctype: str, name: str, query: str = '')
```

<sub>vansale/steelforce/approvals_extra.py:49</sub>

#### `history` - GET / _no perm call_

The decisions the signed-in user took (and what happened to documents they submitted), as Permission Manager lists them, newest first. `limit` counts documents, 1 to 200; `from_date` and `to_date` (YYYY-MM-DD) and `transaction` (PM's label, such as "Sales Return") narrow it, and a blank one does not. Never everybody's history. Empty when Permission Manager is not installed.

```
/api/method/vansale.steelforce.approvals_extra.history
(limit: int = 100, from_date: str = '', to_date: str = '', transaction: str = '')
```

<sub>vansale/steelforce/approvals_extra.py:442</sub>

#### `my_requests` - GET / _no perm call_

The documents the signed-in user submitted that are still moving through approval: one row per document, longest waiting first, with where it is (`state`), who holds it (`holder`, a person's full name, for a forwarded approval the person it was forwarded to), the role it waits on (`role_id`, or "Direct" when it is assigned to a person), `days` waiting and `priority`. Documents that no longer exist or were cancelled, Stock Entry and types PM hides are left out. Empty when Permission Manager is not installed.

```
/api/method/vansale.steelforce.approvals_extra.my_requests
(no arguments)
```

<sub>vansale/steelforce/approvals_extra.py:276</sub>

#### `return_to_originator` - POST / _no perm call_

Hand an approval that was forwarded "return to me" back to the person who asked, through Permission Manager (which also checks it is ad hoc). The caller must hold it open, as for `forward`; otherwise, and for Stock Entry or a type PM hides, the answer is "Approval not found". Returns `{"ok": True}` plus anything PM answers.

```
/api/method/vansale.steelforce.approvals_extra.return_to_originator
(action_id: str, comment: str = '')
```

<sub>vansale/steelforce/approvals_extra.py:193</sub>

#### `sent_back` - GET

The documents an approver sent back to the signed-in user for correction, as Permission Manager lists them (who sent it back, when, the role and the reason), as `{"items": [...], "unavailable": bool}`. `sent_back_on` is a UTC ISO time to the second. When PM cannot build the list for this user (its read of one document type is refused, which it does not handle) the answer is no items and `unavailable` true. Empty when Permission Manager is not installed.

```
/api/method/vansale.steelforce.approvals_extra.sent_back
(no arguments)
```

<sub>vansale/steelforce/approvals_extra.py:415</sub>
